canonical_source.rule: All successor work starts from this main commit. Existing PASS evidence is inherited and must not be redeveloped.

dispatch_semantics.ASSIGNED_NO_ACK: Task has been dispatched in the authoritative ledger but no worker start/ACK receipt is claimed.
dispatch_semantics.RUNNING: May be used only after a source-bound execution receipt or equivalent worker evidence exists.
dispatch_semantics.DONE_SCOPED: Only the finite task scope is complete; never means the whole Cell/domain is complete.
dispatch_semantics.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: No executable local work is claimed for the named blocked scope until the unlock condition exists.
dispatch_semantics.TRIGGER_ARMED: Gate Cell activates only when a new fixed candidate is presented.
